hypothesis: M168 showed that the same staged PPO recipe can pass from M167_5168 but fail from M166 by losing boundary replay row 67, so the next step should make row 67 and similar fragile rows explicit guards before any further PPO stage.
success_criteria: compare the M168 failed and passed branches on boundary replay row 67
extract the fragile boundary rows where parent or stage changes alter success-drop status
define a small explicit fragile-row guard that can run before the full M164 replay
rerun the admitted M168 branch through the explicit guard
do not continue PPO stage 2 unless the fragile-row guard and full M164 replay both pass
failure_criteria: ignore the M168 failed branch because another branch passed
continue PPO stage 2 without checking row 67
select continuation only by fixed objective loss or rollout return
relax the M164 success-drop count threshold

commands.name: m169_row67_fragile_guard
commands.command: Analyze M168 boundary replay rows, identify fragile success-drop rows such as row 67, and create or document a guard that must pass before any stage-2 PPO.

decision_rule: A stage-2 PPO candidate is allowed only after the fragile-row guard preserves row 67 and the full M164 boundary replay gate remains passing.
